body:
## What it does

Tell it your usage percentage and where the weekly window resets, and it hands back a read-out that is easier to judge at a glance than the raw number. Where the reset moment can be pinned down, the exact date and time come with it. The bot only measures; it never changes your account, your plan or your spend.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @BCornTexas shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
